description: This is a PHP class named DggContainer in the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically within the Shared/Escher namespace. It manages data related to drawing group components such as maximum shape IDs, saved drawings, saved shapes, and associated options and identifier clusters.

classes.name: DggContainer
classes.description: A class that manages drawing group data such as shape IDs, drawing counts, associated container, options, and identifier clusters within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: getSpIdMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum shape ID index used across all drawings, plus one.

methods.name: setSpIdMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum shape ID index used across all drawings.

methods.name: getCDgSaved
methods.description: Returns the total number of drawings saved.

methods.name: setCDgSaved
methods.description: Sets the total number of drawings saved.

methods.name: getCSpSaved
methods.description: Returns the total number of shapes saved, including group shapes.

methods.name: setCSpSaved
methods.description: Sets the total number of shapes saved.

methods.name: getBstoreContainer
methods.description: Gets the BLIP store container object.

methods.name: setBstoreContainer
methods.description: Sets the BLIP store container object.

methods.name: setOPT
methods.description: Sets an option for the drawing group by property key.

methods.name: getOPT
methods.description: Retrieves an option value based on the property key.
